conclusions.text: 通过。最终目录与实有集合一致：任务目录只有 root.yaml、prepare_chain.yaml 与 dispatch.md，含 root 共两份完整设计、未超十份上限，root 唯一并保存唯一 Contract，无未计划的草稿或备份 YAML，也没有把额外完整方案藏在其他目录或扩展名下。完整设计表两行都以链接登记（[root](root.yaml)、[prepare_chain](prepare_chain.yaml)），全文已无「仅计划」「P5 写作」「待落实位置」「预计区域安排」「P6 集中补链」等阶段待办；本次固定检查报 directory.kind=final_directory、registered_nodes=[prepare_chain, root]、planned_nodes=[]、missing_nodes=[]。表中两行的机制摘要与保留理由逐项对得上固定来源：root 的 metadata 1×128 排序、grid=request_count*head_count、block 1024、smem 227968、tmem 256 列、四稳态角色与四条 tcgen05 乘积（含 N=160 融合）；prepare_chain 的 prepare grid=ceil(capacity/4)*head_count、block 128、smem 44032、__launch_bounds__(128,5)，chain grid=2*request_count*head_count、block 512、smem 138240、每 CTA 只承担半个 value 行区间、五条独立 MMA 与 3 累加器/7 输出缓冲。三条变体记录均能定位真实基线对象并已补齐并列基线，目录未覆盖任何 YAML 内已固定的选择。

conclusions.subject: selection
conclusions.text: 通过。两份设计的独特价值经源码独立核对成立，不是引用写法或改动篇幅的差异。root 把归一、log2 域衰减前缀（含 decay_offset=16*lower_bound*log2(e) 的分段与 restore_scale/restore_factor 复原）、32×32 三角逆、递推、读出与 checkpoint/final_state 写全部关在一个 CTA 内，仅前置一次 1×128 metadata 提交，状态不出芯片、不依赖跨 kernel 工作区；PREP 以 5 个 4-warp instance 各绑一个流水级（instance i 只处理 c%5==i 的 chunk，num_prep_iters 使其无空转轮次），MMA 由单 warp 发四条乘积并以一条 N=160 融合累加同时更新 state 与 out。prepare_chain 把 intra-chunk 因子的生产者拆成独立 kernel 并经全局工作区跨 CTA 共享，value 行切成两半由两个 CTA 并行，beta 与三角逆已在 prepare 中折叠进 abt/w/qk_t 因而 chain 内不再出现，输出累加与状态更新各自独立成 MMA，且 16-token 因子化使最宽增量仅 -7.21、D >= 2^-116 而无需 root 的范围分段与 restore 遍。两者的主计算、输出形成、工作归属与主协作都需各自贯通，无法由 root 加参数或局部差额表达；两族在 kr 上的数值路径差异（engine 读回已窄化 BF16 再加宽，prepare 直接用 FP32 寄存器值）正是本次修订后各自忠实记录的实例。

conclusions.subject: coverage
conclusions.text: 通过。范围分清、root 无隐式兼底：root 的 when 是 selector 取真且 total_tokens >= 32（该下界唯一来源是 EncodeBetaTma<32,false> 的 kBoxTokens=32 校验，直绑 beta 行数 total_tokens 与补齐工作区行数 max(total_tokens,16) 都受约）；prepare_chain 的 when 是同一 selector 取假，且经核实确实不需 total_tokens 下界：EncodeBt16NativeBetaTma 只校验连续、基址 16 字节对齐与 cols*rows*2 <= 512，token 维写成上取整而无最小值，chain 使用的 EncodeValueTma<64,16> 只要求 token 轴 > 0，其余服务条件为 total_chunks > 0、prepare_total_ctas ∈ [head_count, head_count*total_chunks] 与 grid_x == 2*request_count*head_count，在声明域（request_count >= 1、capacity >= 1）内恒成立。两份设计各自从共同输入贯通到全部三个输出，尾块（root 的 out_tail、prepare_chain 的 tail_zero 与 out_tail）、空工作（PREPARE 的 my_chunks=0、cadence==0 时 checkpoint_block 为 0 槽）与 padded 行中性均分别贯通，未把未提交、无工作与 no-op 混为一谈。selector 取真而 total_tokens < 32 的输入被冻结 host 拒绝这一覆盖空白如实保留，Contract 有效域未因此缩小。

conclusions.text: 通过。P2/P4 已识别机制与 P5 交接的新事实均有最终去处，目录记录直接定位真实基线对象，已无待绑定对象或未来链接：范围小节把 prepare 的编译期特化与 beta 直绑、host capacity 上界与可能为空的 rank、chain 的 checkpoint 粒度与自然顺序、五组因子工作区的跨 kernel 交接、两族共有的 _kda_plan 缓存与同流顺序提交，分别指向 PREPARE.Schedule 与 REALIZATION.Require、Math_reshape 的 chunk 编号步与 checkpoint 步、PREPARE/CHAIN 的 Decomposition 与 Mapping、Flow.Launch/Handoff 与 CHAIN.Schedule。三条变体记录的并列基线均已落实并逐项核实：变体一 -> PREPARE.Schedule Strategy、load:gate_beta 与 raw_beta（原生 pair-packed 直绑，head_count=12 的 432 字节 box 依赖 Require 钉住的 640 字节间隙）；变体二 -> CHAIN.Decomposition Strategy 与 Worktile_order 加 Prefer 的无 metadata 提交（该节点 sort_by_length 无对应对象）；变体三 -> CHAIN.Mapping Strategy 与 Forbid，host 侧 chain_launch.cu::ResolveStatePointerSlots 调用同一 ResolveAndCheckServingStatePoolForDtype，设备侧 state_slot = seq_idx、四个状态索引实参为死实参（两个 FP32 指针由 StatePointerSlots 初始化为 nullptr）。全部结构化引用可解析，来源引用一律固定到 commit 484902855fe…，source_validation 为 verified。

conclusions.subject: differences
conclusions.text: Every claimed difference from the root baseline is mechanism-level and independently source-verified. (1) Submission/materialization: two launches on one stream (PREPARE then CHAIN, start_after PREPARE.kernel_done) with five global workspaces qd/kd/w/qk_t/gt - 13312 B written and 26624 B read per (head,chunk) since both halves read whole blocks - versus root's fused CTA plus 1x128 metadata launch [ev 2,3,4,63,65]. (2) Chunk length 16 with NO decay range split: the widest increment 2*half_scale = -7.21 keeps D >= 2^-116 above the BF16 normal minimum, so no decay_offset/restore_factor/restore pass exists anywhere in prepare.cuh, unlike root's 32-token split [ev 8,12]. (3) Beta and the triangular solve leave the state-carrying kernel: prepare folds beta into abt = diag(beta_w)*inv^T and then into w = abt*kr and qk_t = abt*mqk^T; chain's ABI carries no beta/gate/q/k/a_log/dt_bias at all [ev 19,25,26,28,29,30,32]. (4) A different level-1 inverse: FP16 nilpotent block product with FP32 accumulate plus the exact 16x16 combine inv21 = -binv22*L21*binv11, where root uses per-row FP32 forward substitution; I also identified a suspected operand-wiring deviation inside the diagonal-block product (third mma consumes the rebuilt S fragment with B = L^2, yielding binv = S+S^2L^2 instead of the declared S(I+L^4); 3-step shift example gives 2ab vs ab) - second-order in seed entries, consistent with the frozen acceptance passing within atol .01/rtol .05, requiring no design re-decision, and recorded in handoff for Supervisor kernel-issue triage [ev 20,21,22,23,24,25,68,69,70]. (5) Residual/scale path: u2 = bf16(v - bf16(u_acc)) via sub.rn.bf16x2 (one narrowing more than root's FP32 residual times beta) and scale_value applied once to the FP32 accumulator in the epilogue instead of folded into qd [ev 37,48,49]. (6) Work axes: PREPARE one CTA per (head, contiguous global-chunk rank) over an upper-bound grid that can hand a rank empty work; CHAIN two CTAs per (request,head) splitting the 128 value rows (descriptor boxes 64x16; host-enforced grid), natural request order, no ranking metadata [ev 7,55,58,63,67]. (7) Five separate tcgen05 products per chunk from two MMA warps, including two N=64 state-half updates and a three-slot accumulator ring, instead of root's four including one fused N=160 [ev 51,53]. (8) Service boundary: no total_tokens lower bound, because EncodeBt16NativeBetaTma checks only contiguity, 16-byte alignment and a <=512-byte box while root is limited to total >= 32 by the engine-side 32-token box [ev 64,66].

conclusions.subject: shared_design
conclusions.text: Nothing is inherited by reference: the checker resolves Math_reshape, Work_schedule and Tile_pipeline all to provider = prepare_chain with source_manifest {prepare_chain.yaml, root.yaml}, the reference graph has no edges, and I verified all three regions directly against the fixed source rather than relying on root's approval. What is shared is re-derived locally: the bound host entry and its selector (this node takes the false side, root the true side; the whens are exact complements, and the selector-true-with-total<32 corner remains the documented host-rejected gap) [ev 0,1]; the value-preserving beta_pack prefix both families depend on, which is why this node needs no padded beta workspace [ev 57]; the host-pinned flags (use_state_indices=0, use_initial_state=store_final_state=1, compact state_slot_stride, scale resolution) [ev 3]; the single shared Contract (identical contract_sha256 for both nodes; no CONTRACT key in this file) with its source-record Tolerance citing the same frozen acceptance [ev 68,69,70]; and the same primitive family re-bound in this node's own local REALIZATION (TMA+expect_tx, ldmatrix/stmatrix with async-proxy fences, tcgen05 commits as signaled dones, parity-phase barriers whose reuse guards initialize at a passing phase, setmaxnreg redistribution, register-direct checkpoint/final-state stores) [ev 5,34,35,37,51,53]. The same mathematical object family reappears with the same meanings (qn/kn, Contract decay and beta_w, gt = D_end, qd/kd/ki/kr, seed/inv/mqk, state_inp, u_acc prior, out_acc, checkpoint slot set), each re-defined in local Math rather than copied.

conclusions.subject: walkthrough
conclusions.text: I independently threaded fixed case 8 (lengths [1023,2049], tp 8 -> head_count 12, request_count 2, cadence 64, continuation state, persistent weak-decay distribution, contiguous beta) from the bound entry to all three outputs. Host: total = 3072, parallel_states = 24, so 2*24 = 48 <= sms makes the engine expression false and this design runs; beta is contiguous and aligned so beta_pack is skipped; capacity = 2 + 3070//16 = 193 = chunk_total = 64+129 (bound exactly tight) [ev 1,2,3,4,57,71,72,73]. PREPARE: 588 CTAs (ceil(193/4)*12) of 128 threads, 44032 B, specialized for (12,2); each CTA takes head = rank/49 and 3-4 contiguous global chunks that may span both requests; per chunk it fetches gate+beta (4096+432-byte box into the 256-byte slot plus 640-byte gap) and q+k (8192 B) under two expect_tx groups, forms beta_w by tanh with the eos zero, builds the per-channel log2 prefix into chunk_decay with row 15 as gt written straight to ws_diag, normalizes with rsqrtf(max(sumsq,1e-24)), narrows qd/kd/ki/kr, computes gram = kd*ki^T in two halves, masks with beta_w into seed, inverts via the FP16 block product and combine, scales the transpose into abt, and publishes qk_t = abt*mqk^T and w = abt*kr by direct stores and per-half TMAs; request 0's last chunk (global 63, 15 valid tokens) zeroes its padded row so beta_w, w and qk_t rows vanish there; the end-of-chunk barrier frees every single-buffered region after the bulk-read waits [ev 7,9,11,12,14,16,19,26,28,29,30]. CHAIN: SaveCheckpoints = true (64//16 = 4), 48 CTAs of 512 threads, 138240 B, 256 tmem columns; CTA 0 = (request 0, head 0, value rows 0-63) over 64 chunks, CTA 24 = (request 1, head 0, half 0); per chunk FACTORS waits the two-commit slot-free pair and loads six arrays (15360 B) into ring slot c%8 at workspace chunk chunk_prefix(r)+c; COMPUTE_L/R snapshot s(c-1) to BF16 into state_inp, write checkpoint slot checkpoint_cu_starts[r]+c/4 whenever c%4==0 (16 slots for request 0, 33 for request 1 - exactly the Contract set, m=0 being the stored initial state), decay the FP32 state by gt from the ring and publish the eight-arrival operand readiness, COMPUTE_R additionally forming u2 = bf16(v - bf16(u_acc)); MMA_STATE issues prior + two N=64 state-half updates, MMA_Q issues out_inter + out_intra with commits gating state_inp/u2/ring reuse; EPILOGUE scales by scale_value once in FP32, TMA-stores the 16x64 block at value_split*64 for full chunks and scatters elements below eos for the tail, draining all bulk groups before the three-arrival tmem dealloc; final_state lands in place over initial_state from both key halves [ev 32,36,37,38,42,43,44,45,47,48,49,51,53,55,62,63]. Outputs: attention_output over all 3072 tokens x 12 heads with disjoint half-column producers, final_state, and every checkpoint slot of both requests. Structural variants also traced: cadence = 0 selects chain_m64<false> and the checkpoint store generates no actions (checkpoint_block slot extent 0, Contract checkpoint_states None); a PREPARE rank whose chunk_lo reaches chunk_total owns empty work (mechanism expressed; within the Contract domain capacity <= 2*chunk_total implies P <= chunk_total, so it does not arise); a request of length 1 yields one partial chunk with 15 padded rows handled by the same zeroing path.

conclusions.subject: document_self_contained
conclusions.text: The node's effective full text supports independent understanding: META_DATA carries identity, the frozen Source pin and a self-explanatory English `when` (selector-false side expanded to its literal conditions, with the verified no-lower-bound service boundary and its reason); the three Design regions are complete local definitions requiring no provider; every symbol resolves within the node or the shared Contract (chunk_tokens/chunk_count/chunk_prefix/chunk_total/capacity/value_half/request_slot_count/checkpoint_stride defined in Math; length/cadence/scale_value/key_dim/value_dim and all tensor dtypes from root's Contract; chunk_lo/chunk_hi from PREPARE's Decomposition.Strategy; token_base(g)/eos(g) from Math step 1), so every pipe condition (c == chunk_lo, eos(c) < token_base(c)+chunk_tokens, c+1 < chunk_hi, length vs (c+1)*chunk_tokens, cadence > 0 and c % checkpoint_stride == 0, c >= 7) and every Waiting index window is evaluable from the document itself. No historical context, prior drafts or catalog entries are needed; artifact_evidence covers the full file.

conclusions.subject: document_layering
conclusions.text: Layering is correct and the shared Contract is neither copied nor altered (no CONTRACT key; contract_sha256 identical to root's per the strict check). Math_reshape defines computation, precision and retention only - the lane/shuffle mentions in Arithmetic.Accumulate are reduction-grouping facts of the same kind root's approved Math carries, not thread layouts; no barrier, role or slot appears in Math. Work_schedule defines work decomposition, mapping, submission and the five global handoffs without touching roles or instructions; the beta-pack call precondition and workspace-reuse conditions sit in Schedule.Strategy as the invocation-boundary rules require. Tile_pipeline binds roles, actions, dependencies and the exact smem/tmem/register accounts to the Work_schedule steps and Math values (views bind qd/kd/w/qk_t/gt/state_inp/u_acc/u2/out_acc/s), and cross-step reuse rides on Handoff + commits, not prose. REALIZATION only binds primitives, launch scale, layout capacity (the 640-byte gap), initial barrier phases and dead-residue Forbids - nothing in it re-decides math, work organization or dependencies, and no lower layer overrides a higher one.

conclusions.subject: document_consistency
conclusions.text: One coherent chosen scheme throughout, with input-driven situations separately and correctly expressed: sizes reconcile (Worker_count = partition products for both steps; PREPARE smem 42304 declared + 1024 barriers + 640 pinned gap + 64 pad = 44032 exactly; CHAIN 122880 + 14336 + 1024 = 138240 exactly; tmem 64+128+48+16 = 256 columns exactly; ring byte count 4096*3+512+512+2048 = 15360 = the expect_tx); the empty-work case (PREPARE rank range) is declared without being conflated with no-submission; the tail chunk drives tail_zero, the partial-prefix branch, the complementary epilogue ifs and never-stored padding consistently; cadence = 0 removes the checkpoint actions via if-not-generated semantics (not no-op events) and matches SaveCheckpoints=false plus the Contract's nullable checkpoint_states; every declared action keeps issue/done even when payload-free, and the c-3/c-8 shifted predecessors skip at the declaration window exactly where the initial-phase Require says the first waits pass. The Handoff production region (five Single_tile targets) covers the consumer region (six Iteration blocks minus v) with the slot-range argument stated, and no Waiting edge contradicts a serial-mode or commit-coverage implication.

conclusions.text: Content is design-focused and necessary: Ledger entries quantify real gains and costs (workspace traffic 13312/26624 bytes, extra narrowing of u2, extra product and accumulator ring, no restore multiply) with defined symbols; Arithmetic entries fix every declared approximation site with explicit unknown: bounds and cite the sampling acceptance rather than overclaiming; describes carry only action-specific facts (member splits, storage bindings, primitive guarantees) without restating formulas. conclusions.subject: design
conclusions.text: root.yaml Version 3 对 P2 所选 engine 实例给出完整本地三区与必要 Realization，经逐行源码核实为忠实。Math_reshape：chunk_tokens=32 折叠与 Contract 逐 token 递推等价（我独立推导了 inter/intra 分解：out_acc = state_inp×qd 给出 scale*qn·(Dcum⊙s(c-1))，mqk = qd0×kiᵀ 携带 scale 与 D(tau)/D(tau') 比且 2^∓offset 精确相消，(I+seed)u=u_raw 的三级 BF16 求逆复现参考 solve_triangular，s(c)=s_decayed+u_bf16×kr 复现 end_keys 推进）；decay_offset=16*lower_bound*log2(e) 拆分的 [e^-80,e^80] 范围声明经算术核实（2^115.4=e^80.0，BF16 上限 e^88.7）；全部窄化点（qd 两次、kd/ki/kr/seed/inv 级间/state_inp/u_raw/u_bf16）与近似点（ex2.approx.ftz、tanh-approx sigmoid、__expf、rsqrtf(sum+1e-6) 替代 1e-12 除法）如实写入公式、Arithmetic 与 Ledger，误差界未知处诚实标 unknown: 并以采样记录为据；gt 单次 ftz 下溢代价保留。Work_schedule：ORDER（1×128 thread0 串行、capacity-0 空填充、无消费者 chunk_prefix 如实保留）+MAIN（grid=request_count*head_count、order 表 1:1 预分配、状态槽 compact stride 钉死）与 preprocess.cu/engine_launch.cu/host_helpers.cuh 一致；Flow 两次提交、MAIN start_after ORDER.kernel_done、order 全局 Handoff 匹配同流顺序提交。Tile_pipeline：四角色成员/寄存器预算（168/48 setmaxnreg）、五实例 PREP 固定级、存储账逐项与宏核对（tmem 64+128+32+32=256 列=131072B；arena 5×41984B 视图偏移 g/qd 1024、k/kd 9216、q/ki/kr 17408、prefix 25600、mqk 25600、inv 29696、gt 31744、seed/inv_work=v 32384、beta 41984、beta_w 42500、rate 42628；out 210944×2；gate_bias 227408）全部吻合。REALIZATION 五条 Require、一条 Prefer、两条 Forbid 均通过删除测试且各有源码依据。

conclusions.subject: contract
conclusions.text: The shared Contract is faithful to the fixed sources and readable without them, and both corrections from the previous review are correctly applied. Golden_reference.Gap (line 94) now records that the reference resolves scale by truthiness so scale == 0 also selects key_dim^(-0.5), with Compute governing: I re-verified reference.py line 47 (`scale or 128 ** (-0.5)`) and both implementation paths (solution.py lines 169 and 224, `float(scale or 128 ** (-0.5))`), so the recorded difference is real, the handling is stated, no test progress is written into Gap, and the acceptance source gap was correctly left in Tolerance rather than moved here. Input.scale and Compute step 1's scale_value rule are unchanged, so Compute still governs as DOC1 requires. The Compute step 2 remark (line 55) now conditions the strict bounds on the sigmoid argument exp(a_log[h]) * (g + dt_bias) being finite, which is exactly right: for a finite argument sigmoid lies strictly in (0,1) so log_decay lies strictly in (-5,0) and decay in (exp(-5),1), while the previously over-claimed cases (exp(a_log) overflowing to +inf above roughly 88.7, and inf*0 = NaN when g + dt_bias == 0) are now excluded rather than misstated; the design-relevant contraction fact is kept, not deleted. Task identity: packed ragged KDA prefill where each (request, head) pair runs a token-sequential gated delta-rule recurrence in FP32 over exact BF16 values, with BF16 rounding only at the three declared writes. I re-derived the equivalence with the pinned reference: with in-chunk cumulative decay D_t, decay[t]*s(t-1) expands to D_t*current + sum_{j<t}(D_t/D_j)u[j]kn[j], so u[t] = beta_w[t]*(v[t]-prior_k[t]) - beta_w[t]*sum_{j<t}kk[t,j]u[j], which is precisely the unitriangular system (I + beta*kk)u = rhs the reference solves; prior_q + qk*u over the diagonal-inclusive qk reproduces o[t] on the updated state; end_keys = kn[j]*(D_{n-1}/D_j) reproduces the chunk-end carry. Chunk-of-8 blocking is therefore an evaluation order, not different math, and is correctly not a Gap. Domain verified against the scope materials rather than the implementation: 1..32 requests, lengths 1..16384, total tokens 2..16384, and head_count {8,12,16,24,32,48,64,96}, which I confirmed is exactly the union of 96//tp over tp in {1,2,4,8} with the heads values satisfying heads*tp in {64,96,128,256}. Cadence {0,32,64,128} and lower_bound == -5.0 follow the task declaration, not the implementation's wider cadence % 16 == 0 and lower_bound < 0; that cadence set also keeps every checkpoint boundary on an 8-token chunk edge so the slot formula is realized exactly. Side effects match benchmark_contract.mutates_inputs and writable_views. Version was incremented to 2 for the content change. No further Contract defect found.

conclusions.text: Every required evidence category anchors its bound entry first and then the necessary call chain, and I read all of it personally against the unchanged pinned snapshot (same source_id and source_root as the previous round, so no re-derivation was needed beyond re-verifying the two changed fields). implementation opens at candidate/solution.py::Model.forward — class, full 19-parameter signature and every default — then all entry asserts, the None-output allocation, initial_state passed twice as source and in-place destination, both return sites, and both float(scale or ...) sites; it continues into the kernels only as far as P1 needs: engine.cuh launch_bounds(1024) with the aliasing comment, tid/warp/lane and extern __shared__, __syncwarp with tcgen05.alloc.cta_group::1 parking the tmem base in smem, __syncthreads, chain.cuh tcgen05.ld.sync.aligned and mbarrier.init.shared::cta, and the engine_launch grid/block/smem constants including the absence of any cluster-dimension launch attribute. io anchors metadata.json: identity and description, the D=128 / beta-layout / total-tokens-exceed-one / length-one-sequence facts, the parameter-domain paragraph naming shape_range.json as the dynamic range authority and shape_cases.json as 10 representative workloads, mutates_inputs, all three defined outputs with dtype, shape, V-major and the storage-view-without-identity note, empty scratch_inputs, preserve_input_storage, the default tolerances and the sampled native_unsupported validation scope. input anchors input.py::_make_inputs and its helper: generator asserts, dtypes and shapes, guarded sentinel buffers, both beta_layout branches, every forward kwarg, the cadence assert with prefix-sum slot construction, and writable_views. reference anchors the complete chunked FP32 recurrence plus Model.forward asserts, write-backs and return. acceptance anchors ACCEPTANCE.json in both its fixed and domain sections (identical per-output tolerance blocks), the cadence-0 null-tolerance checkpoint record and the structural return_aliases record, plus PRECISION.md. scope anchors shape_range.json including cross_field_invariants and three shape_cases entries. Per-output acceptance coverage is complete: Tolerance names exactly the three contract outputs with atol=0.01, rtol=0.05, max_mismatch_fraction=0.0 and relative_to=candidate preserved verbatim plus the 'formula absent; no defaults' markers, and the comparisons below bind all six numeric acceptance identities. Retained limits: the frozen checker's combining formula, comparison precision, non-finite handling and routing beyond the mode label are unpublished in the fixed materials, mode=elementwise_and_l2 and max_rel_l2=null cannot fit the 100-character Tolerance budget, and acceptance evidence is sampled (fixed 20 plus domain 20 cases at 2 seeds) with the production baseline unsupported on row-strided shapes 0 and 2.

conclusions.subject: document_self_contained
conclusions.text: root.yaml Version 2 can be understood with no prior context, no directory and no earlier draft. Every scale used in a shape or formula resolves: request_count, total_tokens, head_count and checkpoint_slot_count enter as named shape scales and are bounded or defined in Compute steps 1 and 5; key_dim and value_dim are Constants; length is registered as a mathematical integer with shape [] and dtype not_applicable; cadence is explicitly bound to checkpoint_every_n_tokens at first use so its later uses in steps 4 and 5 resolve; scale_value is registered where defined and consumed by name in step 3. Notation is defined at first use — sigmoid, the key-axis Euclidean norm, bf16(...) as the only rounding point — and the re-qualified decay bound now spells out its own condition (the sigmoid argument exp(a_log[h]) * (g[0,t,h,c] + dt_bias[h*key_dim + c]) being finite) instead of relying on a reader to infer it, which removes the one place where the text previously claimed more than the declared domain supported. Index ranges and reduction axes are written out, the round-bracket recurrence instance is explained, and the two conditions DOC1 forbids omitting — the all-zero q/k row result and whether the readout uses the pre- or post-update state — are both explicit. Nullable handling follows the rule: scale, output, state_checkpoints and checkpoint_states carry nullable true with shape and dtype describing the non-None object, and Compute defines both branches including cadence == 0 where no checkpoint work exists. The new Gap closes the last point that previously required opening reference.py to detect: a reader now learns from the YAML itself that the reference resolves scale by truthiness and that Compute governs. The three outputs, their return positions, their in-place and caller-buffer destinations, the 2- versus 3-tuple return and the exhaustive written set are all locatable in the artifact alone.

conclusions.subject: document_layering
conclusions.text: Layering is correct and the P1 write scope was respected; the revision touched only Algorithm_requirement plus the Version increment. Compute defines the caller-visible task only: no chunk size, tile, buffer, kernel count, CTA configuration, launch heuristic or execution order appears anywhere, and the statements that order expresses dependence only and that (request, head) pairs are unordered keep the recurrence a dependency claim rather than a schedule. Implementation restrictions were not promoted into algorithm premises — the SM103 capability assert, the wider cadence % 16 == 0 and lower_bound < 0 bounds, the beta contiguity/alignment repack path and the engine-versus-prepare/chain occupancy predicate all stay out, while the Contract records the task-declared cadence set and lower_bound == -5.0. Critically, the revision did not repair the scale divergence by importing an implementation behaviour into the math layer: Compute step 1 keeps its own None-only rule and the difference is recorded where DOC1 puts it, in Golden_reference.Gap, so the Contract still governs and the lower layer still does not rewrite an upper one. Hardware_specification.Execution holds only the minimal registration with source basis — thread with register, warp with __syncwarp and warp-collective tcgen05.ld/st on tmem, cta owning smem and tmem and syncing through smem mbarriers — each verified in the fixed kernels; I re-checked whether a cluster level should be registered and concluded it should not, since every launch uses plain grid/block syntax with no cluster-dimension attribute and tcgen05.alloc uses cta_group::1, so the .shared::cluster and cluster-scoped mbarrier forms degenerate to CTA scope and nothing is shared above the CTA. Device, Architecture, Feature, Stack and all Wiki leaves keep the starter placeholders untouched with no capability or capacity claim, and DESIGN is still the unmodified starter skeleton, which P1 permits and which I do not approve; no root representative is selected at this stage.

conclusions.subject: document_consistency
conclusions.text: The artifact now expresses one coherent task with no internal contradiction I can find. Sizes and derived quantities agree end to end: total_tokens = cu_seqlens[request_count] is consistent with the 2..16384 bound and with strictly increasing boundaries giving length_r >= 1, so no zero-length request arises and the reference's chunk loop always runs at least once; checkpoint slot arithmetic agrees between the step 4 index formula j = checkpoint_cu_starts[r] + m, the step 5 prefix-sum property and checkpoint_slot_count as the state_checkpoints slot axis; the cadence == 0 branch is treated as genuinely absent work with checkpoint_states None rather than an executed no-op, while cadence > 0 writes every slot exactly once; and the nullable declarations match the branch conditions in Compute. The two inconsistencies I filed last round are both resolved and neither fix introduced a new one. The scale path is now consistent across three places: Input.scale stays un-ranged so 0.0 remains in the domain, Compute step 1 keeps the None-only resolution plus its declared-domain note, and Gap records that the reference and both implementation paths resolve by truthiness with Compute governing — so a reader is told both what the task requires and where the pinned reference departs from it, instead of being left with a silent contradiction. The decay bound is now consistent with the un-ranged finite a_log domain, since the strict inequalities are asserted only while the sigmoid argument is finite, which is precisely the condition under which they hold; the remark also stays consistent with the generated payloads (A_log = linspace(-2,1), zeroed for the persistent and rapid_decay profiles), which always satisfy it. Tolerance keys match the Output keys exactly and name no undeclared output, and every declared threshold and the relative_to basis are transcribed unaltered.

conclusions.subject: document_relevance
conclusions.text: Content is limited to what a reader needs and no process material leaked into the YAML. There are no revision notes, todos, historical approvals, test-progress entries or repeated decisions; the new Gap states a difference and its handling only, and Golden_reference records no verification or run status. The revision added exactly the necessary text and nothing more — one Gap line and a finiteness qualifier — while keeping the design-relevant contraction bound rather than deleting it because it involves an unknown, which is the right call under the necessity rule. The source-limitation statements that remain are necessary rather than incidental: the Tolerance entries keep the declared thresholds and relative_to=candidate and mark the unpublished combining formula and the non-adoption of default criteria, which is the acceptance source record DOC1 prescribes for a fixed-implementation extraction; the declared-domain remarks about beta layouts, the always-passed scale value and the checkpoint_cu_starts prefix sums record real external constraints the Compute formulas depend on; and the note that both beta layouts carry the same values prevents a reader inferring a second numeric path. Naming is clear and conventional, the Output name checkpoint_states is explicitly tied back to the state_checkpoints input buffer so the deliberate name difference cannot mislead, and a_log is the lowercase registration of the interface parameter A_log as the identifier rules require. Nothing reads as padding or as an optimization rationale, and no Design or performance conclusion is anticipated.

issues.detail: Retained, non-blocking; recorded so the limit stays visible in delivery rather than being closed out by this approval. Every numeric acceptance check in both the fixed and domain sections declares atol=0.01, rtol=0.05, max_mismatch_fraction=0.0, max_rel_l2=null, relative_to=candidate and mode=elementwise_and_l2, but the frozen checker's exact combining formula, comparison precision, non-finite handling and routing beyond the mode label are not published anywhere in the fixed materials, and PRECISION.md only states that the frozen checker was used without relaxing tolerances. The Tolerance entries preserve the declared thresholds and relative_to=candidate verbatim and mark 'formula absent; no defaults', so the default DOC1 criterion interpretation is explicitly not adopted and nothing unknown is asserted as a guarantee. Two further declared labels, mode=elementwise_and_l2 and max_rel_l2=null, cannot be transcribed because the entries already use 99 of the 100 permitted characters; they are tracked by the confirmed framework candidate below and remain in the receipt record. This gap affects only the external pass/fail boundary: the task math, IO, side effects, precision conversions and reference entry are fully determined, so it does not block extraction, and per the reviewer rules it must not be used to re-block later phases once the retained facts and limits are confirmed present. The sampled nature of the evidence (fixed 20 plus domain 20 cases at 2 seeds, with the production baseline unsupported on row-strided shapes 0 and 2) is a separate limit and is likewise retained, not claimed as whole-domain.
issues.recovery_condition: The task owner publishes the frozen checker's comparison formula, precision, non-finite handling and routing, or the Tolerance text budget is widened per the framework candidate, after which the complete criterion including mode=elementwise_and_l2 can be transcribed into Golden_reference.Tolerance instead of living partly in receipt records.

conclusions.subject: mechanisms
conclusions.text: 独立从绑定 host 入口追到设备工作，确认冻结实现只有两个互斥且各自完整的机制族，没有第三条可进入路径。kernel 清单完整：5 个导出入口（metadata、beta_pack、engine run、prepare run、chain run）对应 6 个 kernel（aka_kda_packed_metadata、aka_kda_pack_beta、PackBetaForTmaKernel、kernel_flashkda_bf16_fused_m128、kernel_flashkda_bf16_bt16_prepare、kernel_flashkda_bf16_bt16_chain_m64<SaveCheckpoints>），全部分别归入 root 的调用边界、两族共用前缀或 prepare_chain。root 机制核实：1×128 的 metadata 提交生成长度降序 order，随后 fused_m128 以 grid=request_count*head_count、block=1024、动态 smem 227968 B、256 列 tmem、32 token 一块、5 级环推进；32 个 warp 中承担稳态工作的只有 compute(0-3，每线程一个 value 行，做 FP32 状态读改写、bf16 快照、按通道衰减、残差，并直接写全局 checkpoint 与 final_state)、epilogue(4-7，整块经 stmatrix+TMA 落 32×128、尾块逐元素写)、mma(9)、prep(12-31，5 个 instance 各绑一级，TMA 载入 q/k/g/beta/v 并以 warp 级 mma.sync 构造 inv 与 mqk)；beta_prefetch(8) 函数体为空、aux_mma(10-11) 只声明一个未用相位变量，warp 10 只做 21 组 87 个 mbarrier 初始化、warp 0 只做 256 列 tmem 分配。engine.cuh 的 tcgen05.mma 只出现在 1562-1590、1609-1637、1661-1665、1685-1689 四处且全部位于 warp == 9 区段内，第四条以 D=taddr+64、A=u2_inp、累加标志 1 与不同指令描述符配合 tmem 列布局（state 64..191、out 192..223）确实是 state 与 out 的融合累加，故不存在第二条 MMA 发射路径。残留机械核实：checkpoint_pipe 的两组 barrier 与 work_item_ready(648)、short_beta_ready(656) 只在 warp 10 的初始化循环里被 init，其地址宏全文无任何 wait/arrive；epilogue、aux_mma、mma、prep 各声明一个 _phase_work_item_ready_0* 后从未使用；_phase_short_beta_ready 只被声明与翻转而无对应 barrier 操作；smem_checkpoint(228352，超出 SMEM_TOTAL 227968) 与 smem_short_n32_v 声明后未使用；SPLIT_WORK_ITEMS 与 STORE_BACKWARD_TAPE 固定为 0。prepare_chain 机制核实：prepare 按 (head, 全局 16-token chunk 区间) 分工、每线程固定一个 key 通道、用设备端 bt16_chunk_prefix 取真实 chunk 数、把 beta 折进 16×16 三角逆并把 qd/kd/w/qk/diag 物化到全局工作区；chain 以 2*request_count*head_count 个 512 线程 CTA、每 CTA 64 个 value 行运行，7 个角色为 epilogue(0-3)、compute_left(4-7)、compute_right(8-11)、mma_q(12)、mma_state(13)、factors(14)、idle(15)，factors 用一次 expect_tx 挂 6 次 TMA 送进 8 级环，compute_left/right 分掌 key 列 0-63 与 64-127，残差由 compute_right 用 sub.rn.bf16x2 以 bf16 完成，mma_q 与 mma_state 合计五条 MMA，epilogue 以 3 个轮转 tmem 累加器与 7 个 smem 缓冲 TMA 落 16×64。上一轮指出的两处机制表述错误（空指针读取位置、角色计数）已按源码修正并本轮复核。

conclusions.subject: root_choice
conclusions.text: 认可 root 选择。engine 实例是真实源码实例而非拼接基线：RunM128N32 的 grid/block/smem 常量、三个 static_assert 与启动语句构成明确的提交身份，前置只有一次 1×128 的 metadata 提交。它的主要接口最便于理解与比较——一个 CTA 对应 Contract 中一个 (request, head) 对并承担其全部 128 个 value 行与完整状态，没有跨 CTA 的值切分，也不依赖任何跨 kernel 工作区，Contract 的递推、读出与三类写回能逐条映射到 compute/mma/epilogue 的动作；它自足，读者无需先理解第二份设计。它确实不是最通用的方案（cadence 须为 32 的倍数、且只在 parallel_states 相对 SM 数足够大时被选中），因此 root 自身必须写 when，dispatch 已明确这一点并把 when 留给 P3，符合 P2 分工。prepare_chain 不是它的派生，两者并列，关系栏表述正确。

conclusions.subject: selection
conclusions.text: 认可拟完整集合为 root + prepare_chain 共 2 份（含 root，远低于 10 份上限），plan 原样回传 plan_draft。把 prepare 与 chain 合成一个节点是正确粒度：prepare 单独不产出任何 Contract 输出，chain 依赖 prepare 物化的因子，二者在同一 CUDA 流上固定顺序提交，构成一个含两次 Launch 的端到端方案；拆成两份会产生无法从输入贯通到输出的节点。prepare_chain 相对 root 的独特价值经独立核对落在四项主要机制上而非引用写法：intra-chunk 因子的生产者由 CTA 内 prep 角色变为独立 kernel 并经全局工作区跨 CTA 共享（beta 与 16×16 三角逆被折进 w 与 qk，chain 内因此完全不存在 beta 与求逆）；工作归属由 1 个 CTA 承担一个 (request,head) 的全部 128 个 value 行，变为 prepare 按 (head, chunk 区间) 均分、chain 由 2 个 CTA 各承担 64 个 value 行且状态再按 key 列半分给 compute_left/right；输出形成由 32×128 单累加器加一条融合 state+out 的累加 MMA，变为 16×64、3 个轮转 tmem 累加器与 7 个 smem 缓冲、五条独立 MMA；主协作由 4 个实际角色 5 级单链变为 7 个角色 8 级跨 kernel 生产消费环。这些差额无法围绕 root 已有值、step、role 或存储说清，不能降级为参数或局部记录。三条降级为目录参数记录的差额层级判断正确：beta TMA 缓冲来源、请求处理顺序、状态槽跨步与索引间接都只改变一个已有取值及其可明确说明的联动，主体机制不变；其中第三条经修正后已准确区分两种取值的 host 约束（基线下 state_slot_stride 被钉死为 head_count*128*128 且 initial_state.numel() 恰为 request_count*head_count*128*128，只有索引间接才允许更大池视图），与共享 Contract 的 initial_state shape 登记一致。两条以纯文本记在范围小节的 prepare_chain 线索符合「只链接实际存在的文件、未来文件用普通文本并标明仅计划」的要求；capacity >= 设备端真实 chunk 数的论证成立，因 Σ floor((l_r-1)/16) <= floor(Σ(l_r-1)/16)。不作为设计处理的项（两个宏为 0、checkpoint_pipe 与 smem_checkpoint/smem_short_n32_v/work_item_ready/short_beta_ready 为未使用残留、两个空角色、beta_pack 与 PackBetaForTmaKernel 与 metadata 并入所属设计的调用边界、problem/solution.py 为生产对照）均经源码核实。

conclusions.subject: coverage
conclusions.text: 本轮为回执补正，产物与上轮逐字节相同（digest 与 base_checkpoint 一致），已亲读确认第 18、19、30 行修正原文仍在、root.yaml META_DATA 未变，上轮完成的有效全文审阅与源码核实对本次产物同样适用。上轮已逐项核实：dispatch.md 全文与 root.yaml 全文；engine.cuh 中 cu_chunk_offsets 的全部三个使用点（864 无条件且 fallback_head 无消费者、1175 无条件、1254 在守卫内）及其消费者 1196-1235；六个 Role 守卫与 beta_prefetch/aux_mma 的空函数体、warp 8-11 的 setmaxnreg、warp 10 的 barrier 初始化与 648/656 两组 barrier 的 init 循环、warp 0 的 256 列 tmem alloc、work_item_ready/short_beta_ready/checkpoint_ready/checkpoint_free 的地址宏与四处未用相位变量、_phase_short_beta_ready 只有声明与翻转、smem_short_n32_v 与 smem_checkpoint 的声明、tcgen05.mma 全部发射点均落在 warp == 9 区段；host_helpers.cuh 的 kHeadDim=128 与 kBetaTmaHeadsPerBox=8、active_state_slots 与 numel 约束、ResolveAndCheckServingStatePoolForDtype 的 0/1 校验与等式分支、索引间接分支的池 shape/stride/对齐/槽数核定、CheckServingAuxiliaryNoOverlap 的条件检查、PackBetaForTmaIfNeeded、32 token 粒度。未逐行展开且不影响本次判断的部分：三条 kernel 内内联 asm 的 swizzle 地址公式与 ldmatrix/stmatrix 的 lane 映射、engine 中 kr/restore_factor 的重构算式与 final_trans 四个 mqk 象限的发布点、prepare 中 w 因子的 fold_slot 面板划分、以及指令描述符的逐位解码（N=160 由 tmem 列区间相邻、D=taddr+64、累加标志 1 与描述符 id 与前三条不同共同支持）。这些属同一机制内的地址与布局实现，不改变主要计算、输出归属、工作分配或协作关系，留待 P3/P5 按需回查。设备 SM 数确认无来源（全仓库仅 solution.py:100 一处引用 multi_processor_count，SUMMARY.json 只有 locked_sm_mhz 与 gpu_uuid）；两族可达性的形状算术经 input.py 的 h = heads or 96//tp 与用例 0/2/8 复核成立。

conclusions.subject: document_self_contained
conclusions.text: 通过。dispatch.md 可无需历史上下文独立读懂：范围小节交代实现范围、共用归一、selector 与两族去向；具体未知边界三条各自给出事实、来源限制与对下游的约束；完整设计表两行各自写明主要机制与保留理由，root 行对 32 个 warp 全部可定位（4 个稳态角色 + 2 个空角色 + 2 处启动期设置），上一轮「6 个角色却只列举 4 个」的缺项已消除；未来文件 prepare_chain.yaml 以纯文本加（仅计划）标注，实际链接只有 root.yaml 且有效；三条变体记录都给出基线、差异与联动、条件与依据，暂拟对象名明确标注由 P3/P4 落实。root.yaml 的 Contract 无需 Design 即可据以写出朴素参考计算，输入、输出、符号、递推、写回、返回元组与验收来源记录均可定位。

conclusions.subject: document_layering
conclusions.text: 通过。root.yaml 只有 root 保存 CONTRACT；Hardware_specification 仅在 Execution 登记有据的 thread/warp/cta 三级，Feature.mechanism 为 null、其余保持 starter 占位，符合 P1 硬件占位边界；DESIGN 三区仍是骨架，未把 P2 的机制概览提前写成 Design 决定，也未提前填写属于 P3 的 META_DATA.Dispatch.when；Version 保持 2，未因草案写作递增。dispatch.md 没有覆盖或改写 YAML 中任何已定内容：三条变体记录都明确以 root 的暂拟对象为基线、只描述取值与联动，且精确参数、when 与修订号以 YAML 为准；范围小节记录的 selector 与断言属实现事实，未被升级为 Contract 约束（Contract 仍按声明域登记 head_count、cadence 与 lower_bound）。修正后新增的 host 校验细节写在变体记录的联动项里，属目录应承担的内容，未渗入 YAML。

conclusions.subject: document_consistency
conclusions.text: 通过，上一轮三处不一致均已消除并本轮复核。第 18 行与 engine.cuh 一致：864 与 1175 的加载在无条件代码里发出，被 STORE_BACKWARD_TAPE != 0 守卫的是 tape_e/tape_x/tape_r 的写与 1254 的第三处 chunk_global_r 加载，死亡原因是结果无活跃消费者，且 PRECISION.md 的采样通过与这一读法相容。第 30 行的角色计数与列举一致，32 个 warp 全部记账（compute 0-3、epilogue 4-7、空 beta_prefetch 8、mma 9、空 aux_mma 10-11、prep 12-31），并区分启动期设置与稳态角色；第 19 行的残留清单逐项可核（barrier 只初始化不收发、四处未用相位变量、smem_checkpoint 越界、两个宏为 0）。第 50 行按 use_state_indices 两种取值分别写清约束，与 host_helpers.cuh 398-407、321-331、410-444、528-533 一致，也与 root.yaml 把 initial_state 登记为恰 request_count 个槽相容。其余一致性经复核成立：selector 表达式与 solution.py 96-107 逐字相符及其化简正确；cadence 16/48 只能走 prepare/chain 的推论与两侧粒度检查一致；两个完整设计单元格的启动配置与绑定层常量及 static_assert 全部相符；变体一与变体二的取值、联动与「不会进入」判断有源码支持；capacity 公式、_kda_plan 缓存键与「工作区不是 Contract 输出」与 runtime.py 一致；plan 的两条 instance 与完整设计表、范围小节及实际启动点一致；root.yaml 的 Contract 与 reference.py、input.py、shape_range.json、ACCEPTANCE.json 的判据标签相互一致（checkpoint 槽公式、scale 真值解析的 Gap、三个输出的写回与返回元组）。

conclusions.subject: design
conclusions.text: root.yaml Version 3 对 P2 所选 engine 实例给出完整本地三区与必要 Realization，经逐行源码核实为忠实。Math_reshape：chunk_tokens=32 折叠与 Contract 逐 token 递推等价（我独立推导了 inter/intra 分解：out_acc = state_inp×qd 给出 scale*qn·(Dcum⊙s(c-1))，mqk = qd0×kiᵀ 携带 scale 与 D(tau)/D(tau') 比且 2^∓offset 精确相消，(I+seed)u=u_raw 的三级 BF16 求逆复现参考 solve_triangular，s(c)=s_decayed+u_bf16×kr 复现 end_keys 推进）；decay_offset=16*lower_bound*log2(e) 拆分的 [e^-80,e^80] 范围声明经算术核实（2^115.4=e^80.0，BF16 上限 e^88.7）；全部窄化点（qd 两次、kd/ki/kr/seed/inv 级间/state_inp/u_raw/u_bf16）与近似点（ex2.approx.ftz、tanh-approx sigmoid、__expf、rsqrtf(sum+1e-6) 替代 1e-12 除法）如实写入公式、Arithmetic 与 Ledger，误差界未知处诚实标 unknown: 并以采样记录为据；gt 单次 ftz 下溢代价保留。Work_schedule：ORDER（1×128 thread0 串行、capacity-0 空填充、无消费者 chunk_prefix 如实保留）+MAIN（grid=request_count*head_count、order 表 1:1 预分配、状态槽 compact stride 钉死）与 preprocess.cu/engine_launch.cu/host_helpers.cuh 一致；Flow 两次提交、MAIN start_after ORDER.kernel_done、order 全局 Handoff 匹配同流顺序提交。Tile_pipeline：四角色成员/寄存器预算（168/48 setmaxnreg）、五实例 PREP 固定级、存储账逐项与宏核对（tmem 64+128+32+32=256 列=131072B；arena 5×41984B 视图偏移 g/qd 1024、k/kd 9216、q/ki/kr 17408、prefix 25600、mqk 25600、inv 29696、gt 31744、seed/inv_work=v 32384、beta 41984、beta_w 42500、rate 42628；out 210944×2；gate_bias 227408）全部吻合。REALIZATION 五条 Require、一条 Prefer、两条 Forbid 均通过删除测试且各有源码依据。

conclusions.subject: walkthrough
conclusions.text: 独立贯通一例具体调用（固定用例 0：lengths=[512]、tp=1→heads=96、cadence=0、row_strided beta）：forward 断言通过→beta 非连续触发 beta_pack 值不变收集→selector：cadence 0%32==0 ∧ 2*96=192>sms 取真→plan(engine)：capacity 0、order int32[1]→metadata<<<1,128>>> sort=1 写 order=[0]→beta_tma 直绑（96%8==0∧512>=16）→engine<<<96,1024,227968>>>。CTA w：seq=order[w/96]=0、head=w%96；warp0 alloc 256 列 tmem、warp10 初始化 87 barrier、compute 4 warp inc168。16 个满 chunk：PREP 实例 c%5 TMA g+beta(tx8704)/k/q(tx16384)→beta_w→FP32 顺序 log2 前缀→rsqrtf 归一折 scale→qd0/kd/ki→seed（3 warp mma.sync 严格下三角×beta 行）→mqk（warp2 对角掩码块+warp1 行16-31 两块+零象限显式发布）→restore（gt、qd 就地二窄、kr 覆 ki）→inv（8×8 前代→2×16×8→32×16，右上零发布）→fence+qk_full→v TMA；COMPUTE 精确宽化播种 s(-1)=0（state_mode zero）→快照 state_inp→arrive→gt 衰减→u_raw=beta_w*(v−u_acc*restore_scale)→v_free/u_inp_ready→u_bf16 覆 u_raw→u_final_ready→fused_ready；MMA warp9 依次 out_inter(init)/u_acc(init)→commit、u(init)→commit、fused N=160 enable_input_d=1 累加 s_decayed 与 out_acc→commit；EPILOGUE 读 out_acc 入寄存器→out_empty→c>=2 时 wait_group.read 1 释放 c−2 槽→stmatrix.trans+TMA 落 32×128 块。末 chunk 后 final_state bf16 就地写回、双 dealloc arrive、MMA 释放 tmem；返回 (output, initial_state) 二元组。三个输出与 Contract 逐项对应。分支情形另核：尾块（cp.async 零填充、padded beta_w=0/log2_decay=0、out_token<eos 散写、s(c) 在 eos 正确）；cadence>0（入口槽 m=0 + in-loop (c+1)*32<length∧%cadence==0 于槽 starts+m，与参考块起点写点集合一致，如 length=2049/cadence=64 恰 33 槽）；单 chunk/length=1（无空工作，length>=1 恒有 chunk_count>=1）；首轮 c−5/c−1 前驱按声明窗口跳过且初始相位 1 放行。

conclusions.subject: dependencies
conclusions.text: 跨角色依赖与寿命链逐项对源码核实且无缺边/多余边：qk_full（fence.proxy.async+实例 barrier 后 arrive）向 COMPUTE/MMA 发布全部 stage 操作数；commit 型信号 old_out_ready+raw_inputs_free（=prod_done，覆盖 MMA1/2）、u2_acc_ready（=u_done）、final_ready+smem_free（=fused_done，tcgen05 commit 累积覆盖前序乘积）分别回流 COMPUTE 的 u_acc/u/checkpoint 读、EPILOGUE 的 out_acc 读与 PREP 的 kr/mqk/inv 释放。stage 复用链完整：g/k 字节←prod_done(c−5)（qd/kd 被 MMA1/2 读完）；q 字节←fused_done(c−5)（kr 被 MMA4 读完；源码额外的 v_free 等待经 COMPUTE 串行链 fused_done⟹u_final_ready⟹v_free 传递覆盖，省略合法）；beta_w←v_free(c−5)（COMPUTE u_raw 读完）；prefix 整区（含 mqk/inv/gt 别名）←fused_done(c−5)+v_free(c−5)；seed←v_free(c−5)（v 槽头部字节）；v←inv(c)（seed 消费完），v(c−5) 经 seed 边传递。tmem 列复用：u(c) 覆 state_inp 低 32 列由同 CTA tcgen05 顺序执行保证（describe+Require#2 显式记录）；u_bf16 覆 u_raw 由 u_done 等待保证；out 单缓冲由 out_empty（初始相位 1、EPILOGUE 读毕 arrive、MMA c−1 边）门控；decay_state(c) 与 MMA4(c−1) 由 COMPUTE 串行 fused_ready(c−1) 分隔。out_smem 双缓冲由 wait_group.read 1（c>=2）保护读毕覆写、尾块不占用、wait_group 0 排空先于 dealloc。COMPUTE 串行管序内 state_inp(c) 覆 u(c−1) 安全。初始化序（warp10 barrier→warp0 tmem→syncthreads）与五个复用守卫 barrier 初始相位 1 由 Require#1/#5 交接，首轮无死锁。残留机械（checkpoint_pipe/short_n32_v/work_item/short_beta/空角色 warp8、10-11、死 cu_chunk_offsets/num_sequences/tape 加载）经独立 grep 复核确未参与任何事件或存储关系，未进入设计，Forbid 记录恰当。

conclusions.subject: document_self_contained
conclusions.text: 独立理解成立：仅凭当前 root.yaml（含完整 Contract）与 dispatch.md 草案即可解释任务、设计全部输入输出、符号、条件与引用——chunk_tokens/chunk_count/decay_offset/B/restore_scale/prefix/gt/restore_factor/qd0/qd/kd/ki/kr/seed/inv/mqk/state_inp/s_decayed/u_acc/prior/u_raw/u/u_bf16/out_acc/request_slot_count 均先定义后使用；length/cadence/scale_value 等溯源自 Contract；order/chunk_prefix 由 ORDER Single_tile 定义；worker_id 为 DOC4 派生量；PREP 实例↔chunk c%5 绑定、事件与视图形参在 Describe 中闭合；when 自足描述承担范围（selector+total>=32）无需历史。仅 'eos' 作为请求末界的非正式缩写在两处出现，可由 Contract 分段定义（cu_seqlens[r+1]）直接解析，不构成缺项。

conclusions.subject: document_layering
conclusions.text: 分层正确：Contract 只定任务（无 chunk/CTA/tile 泄漏，tolerance 保留来源记录且声明不采用默认解释，Gap 只记 scale 真值差异）；Math_reshape 无线程布局/屏障编号（step3 Accumulate 记录 4×FP32x2 FMA+16 lane XOR 树的归约分组属规范允许的累加方式表达，非指令组织）；Work_schedule 无 role/原语细节，beta TMA 绑定与 order 就绪作为调用前提写入 Schedule.Strategy，符合调用边界规则；Tile_pipeline 只声明动作/依赖/存储，原语（tcgen05.commit 语义、TMA expect_tx、cp.async 零填充、mbarrier 相位）全部由 REALIZATION 绑定；Realization 未重决数学/角色/缓冲，五条 Require 均为上游留在抽象层的必要条件（含 DOC5/DOC6 明确允许的启动规模与寄存器预算交接），Prefer/Forbid 通过删除测试。目录未覆盖 YAML 决定，变体仅记录参数取值。

conclusions.subject: document_consistency
conclusions.text: 全文一致：单一已选方案贯穿三区——尺寸链（chunk_tokens 32、value/key 128、N=160=128+32、tmem 64+128+32+32=256 列、arena 20992 bf16/级×5+out 8192×2+gate_bias 512 ≤ 227968）处处吻合；每个 Using_verb 声明与 Pipe 动作一一对应且参数个数一致，Waiting 引用的每个事件均由对应角色 Pipe 实际产生，左侧均属当前角色；Index c 域 [0,chunk_count] 与四角色 for(c) 及 c−5/c−1 窗口边界一致，空域/首轮情形由初始相位 Require 与窗口跳过规则闭合；改变事件存在性的情形分别贯通（cadence>0 增加 checkpoint_entry/checkpoint 动作、cadence=0 无；满块 TMA 路径与尾块散写路径用同一不变判定值 length>=(c+1)*chunk_tokens 的互补 if；c>=2 才有 out_slot 释放；length>=1 保证无空工作）；Handoff/ready/wait_at 默认规则使用正确（start_after ORDER.kernel_done 已覆盖 order 就绪，无冗余登记）；EPILOGUE out_staged 槽 c%2 与 output_stage 翻转一致。

conclusions.subject: document_relevance
conclusions.text: 内容必要性成立：Thesis 三篇均写取舍与代价而非复述字段；Ledger 只记公式不易看出的收益/代价（链长折叠、窄化点计数、ftz 下溢）；未知误差界按规范写 unknown: 并保留采样依据，未虚构实验；来源限制（近似原语、死 ABI、残留机械、total>=32 服务边界）保留在 Forbid/Describe/when 与既有 issue 中而非删除；无退修记录、历史批准或过程状态混入 YAML；Dispatch.when 未复述 Contract 约束；dispatch.md 的未知边界与变体条目均为影响理解/使用的必要事实。REALIZATION 无夹带设计决定。

conclusions.subject: directory
conclusions.text: dispatch.md 符合 common「选择条件与索引」的唯一最小格式，严格检查通过（本次 check-helper exit 0：raw_passed=true、无 corrections/diagnostics，directory yaml=[root.yaml]、registered=[root]、planned=[prepare_chain]、missing=[prepare_chain] 为 P4 预期状态）。标题沿用任务名，「范围」「完整设计」齐备，「变体与组合」有三条实际条目、无空小节。完整设计表登记两份（含 root，远低于 10 份上限）：root 行为已交付基线并给出实际链接，机制摘要与我逐项核对的 root.yaml 定义一致（ORDER 1×128 长度降序、MAIN grid=request_count*head_count/block 1024/227968 B/256 列 tmem、PREP warp12-31 五实例、COMPUTE warp0-3、MMA warp9 四条乘积与一条 N=160 融合、EPILOGUE warp4-7 满块 TMA 与尾块散写），并在括号内如实记账 beta_prefetch(warp8) 空体、aux_mma(warp10-11) 只声明未用相位变量、warp10 初始化 21 组 87 个 mbarrier、warp0 分配 256 列 tmem，使 32 个 warp 全部可定位；prepare_chain 行以普通文本标注「仅计划」、无假链接，全文唯一链接目标 root.yaml 真实存在。三条变体均以（参数）类型标注并锚定 root.yaml 真实对象（MAIN.Schedule.Strategy 与 PREP 的 load:gate_raw/compute:beta 及 stage_arena.beta_c(c)；MAIN.Decomposition.Partition.task+Strategy、Worktile_order、ORDER 的 order 目标与 compute:metadata；MAIN.Mapping.Strategy 与 COMPUTE 的 state_init/checkpoint_entry/checkpoint/final_state），来源选择条件（solution.py 的 beta_tma 选择式、preprocess 的 sort_by_length 分支、host 恒传 use_state_indices=0）、设计成立条件（以 when 为准，EncodeBetaTma 的 8×32 box 与 16 字节 token 跨步校验）与实验覆盖（PRECISION.md 采样、未逐样本标注分支）三类证据分别表述，精确参数与 when 明确以 YAML 为准，目录未覆盖或改写任何 YAML 决定。

conclusions.subject: writing_plan
conclusions.text: 唯一非 root 代表 prepare_chain 的写作计划足以让新作者定位实例、理解实质差异与必要依赖，回执 plan 原样回传 plan_draft=[{id: prepare_chain, wait_for: []}]（恰好覆盖已选非 root，无自依赖与循环，我独立认可当前选择与安排）。六项要素齐备且经我对固定来源复核：① 具体实例成立——RunBt16Prepare 以 host 计算的 grid=ceil(capacity/4)*heads 启动 kernel_flashkda_bf16_bt16_prepare（128 线程、44032 B、__launch_bounds__(128,5)、按 -DAKA_KDA_HEADS/-DAKA_KDA_SEQUENCES 特化并按 (heads,sequences) 缓存），随后 RunBt16Chain 以 host 强校验的 grid=2*request_count*head_count 启动 kernel_flashkda_bf16_bt16_chain_m64<checkpoint_stride_chunks>0>（512 线程、138240 B）；② 相对 root 的实质差异有来源依据——qd/kd/w/qk/diag 五组因子由独立 kernel 物化到全局工作区并跨 CTA 共享（qd/kd/w 经 TMA store、qk/diag 经直接全局写），beta 与 16×16 三角逆已折进因子故 chain 内不存在 beta 与求逆；chain 每 CTA 只承担 64 个 value 行（value_split_idx=blockIdx.x%2）且状态按 key 列半分给 compute_left(warp4-7)/compute_right(warp8-11)；输出为 16×64 块、3 个轮转 tmem 累加器与 7 个 smem 缓冲、五条独立 MMA（out=state_inp×qd、out+=u×qk、u_acc=state_inp×kd、state+=u×w_left、state+=u×w_right），对照 root 的 32×128 单累加器与一条 N=160 融合；主协作由 7 个角色 8 级环（factors 一次 expect_tx 挂 6 次 TMA）对照 root 的 4 个角色 5 级环，故不能降为参数或局部记录；③ 预计区域安排写明三区计划完整本地定义、不计划整区 from，实际共享由 P5 审过来源后决定、P6 对齐；④ 先后顺序可成立：只依赖已存在的 root.yaml（共享 Contract 与比较基线），无未来文件依赖、无相互等待；⑤ 待落实位置明确：新建 prepare_chain.yaml、Dispatch.id=prepare_chain、Name/Describe 同 root、不复制 Contract、when 承担 selector 取假侧并写实服务边界与 cadence//16 粒度；⑥ 未来文件一律普通文本标注仅计划，未写成已定义，也未把拟共享写成已证明相同。计划中 capacity>=设备端 bt16_chunk_prefix 真实 chunk 数的论证成立（ceil(l/16)=floor((l-1)/16)+1 且 Σfloor((l_r-1)/16)<=floor((total-N)/16)），grid 也满足 CheckBt16PrepareInputs 的 [H, H*total_chunks] 约束。

conclusions.subject: coverage
conclusions.text: P2/P3 交下的已识别知识全部有去处，本轮未发现新缺口。① 三条参数记录已落实为锚定真实对象的正式变体条目，两条 prepare_chain 纯文本线索扩写为计划要点（编译期特化与模块缓存、EncodeBt16NativeBetaTma 免补齐、capacity 公式与设备端真实 chunk 数、chain 的 cadence//16→SaveCheckpoints 与自然请求顺序、_kda_plan 工作区缓存与同流提交顺序），共有工作区知识分别指明 root 侧落点（ORDER 目标、Handoff.order、变体一）与 prepare_chain 侧落点（P5 的提交、Handoff 与调用边界）。② P3 source_limitation 的恢复条件已履行：范围第 11 行记录 engine 路径 total_tokens>=32 服务边界（EncodeBetaTma 的 8 head×32 token box 校验，直绑 beta 行数 total 与补齐工作区行数 max(total,16) 皆须 >=32）与 selector 取真∧total<32 的覆盖缺口（host 抛错、非数值损坏、Contract 有效域不缩小），变体一条件栏已把 >=16 更正为以 when 的 >=32 为准。③ 死 ABI 与残留机械去向明确：两处无守卫加载（total_chunks/fallback_head、chunk_global_e/tape_ex_base）因结果无活跃消费者而被消除、第三处 chunk_global_r 在 STORE_BACKWARD_TAPE 守卫内，smem_checkpoint 偏移 228352 超出 227968 分配、smem_short_n32_v 与 work_item_ready/short_beta_ready 只初始化不收发、两个空角色，全部落在 root.yaml 的 REALIZATION.Forbid/Prefer，未进入设计输入、存储账或角色表。④ sms 无来源的缺口如实保留（两份 when 只能引用 selector 表达式并注明 sms 是 host 读取的运行时 SM 数），两族可达性（用例 0/1/2 的 2P=192/1536 走 engine、用例 4/5/8 的 2P=24/48 走 chain，需 sms∈[48,192)）与采样分支覆盖仍限定为按形状推得、不得升级为逐用例保证。⑤ 不存在已研究但未完整展开的独立候选，故未增设空小节；已选完整集合为 2 份，均有独特价值，无为提供共享区域而增设的文件。⑥ P1 遗留的外部 checker 公式缺口仍由 Supervisor 渠道处理，root.yaml 的 Tolerance 保留已知阈值、比较对象与 formula absent/no defaults 标注，符合 DOC1「固定实现提取中的验收记录」的写法，本轮独立核对该条规则后未发现需要新增或确认的框架问题。

conclusions.subject: document_self_contained

conclusions.text: 通过。最终目录与实有集合一致：任务目录只有 root.yaml、prepare_chain.yaml 与 dispatch.md，含 root 共两份完整设计、未超十份上限，root 唯一并保存唯一 Contract，无未计划的草稿或备份 YAML，也没有把额外完整方案藏在其他目录或扩展名下。完整设计表两行都以链接登记（[root](root.yaml)、[prepare_chain](prepare_chain.yaml)），全文已无「仅计划」「P5 写作」「待落实位置」「预计区域安排」「P6 集中补链」等阶段待办；本次固定检查报 directory.kind=final_directory、registered_nodes=[prepare_chain, root]、planned_nodes=[]、missing_nodes=[]。表中两行的机制摘要与保留理由逐项对得上固定来源：root 的 metadata 1×128 排序、grid=request_count*head_count、block 1024、smem 227968、tmem 256 列、四稳态角色与四条 tcgen05 乘积（含 N=160 融合）；prepare_chain 的 prepare grid=ceil(capacity/4)*head_count、block 128、smem 44032、__launch_bounds__(128,5)，chain grid=2*request_count*head_count、block 512、smem 138240、每 CTA 只承担半个 value 行区间、五条独立 MMA 与 3 累加器/7 输出缓冲。三条变体记录均能定位真实基线对象并已补齐并列基线，目录未覆盖任何 YAML 内已固定的选择。

conclusions.subject: selection
conclusions.text: 通过。两份设计的独特价值经源码独立核对成立，不是引用写法或改动篇幅的差异。root 把归一、log2 域衰减前缀（含 decay_offset=16*lower_bound*log2(e) 的分段与 restore_scale/restore_factor 复原）、32×32 三角逆、递推、读出与 checkpoint/final_state 写全部关在一个 CTA 内，仅前置一次 1×128 metadata 提交，状态不出芯片、不依赖跨 kernel 工作区；PREP 以 5 个 4-warp instance 各绑一个流水级（instance i 只处理 c%5==i 的 chunk，num_prep_iters 使其无空转轮次），MMA 由单 warp 发四条乘积并以一条 N=160 融合累加同时更新 state 与 out。prepare_chain 把 intra-chunk 因子的生产者拆成独立 kernel 并经全局工作区跨 CTA 共享，value 行切成两半由两个 CTA 并行，beta 与三角逆已在 prepare 中折叠进 abt/w/qk_t 因而 chain 内不再出现，输出累加与状态更新各自独立成 MMA，且 16-token 因子化使最宽增量仅 -7.21、D >= 2^-116 而无需 root 的范围分段与 restore 遍。两者的主计算、输出形成、工作归属与主协作都需各自贯通，无法由 root 加参数或局部差额表达；两族在 kr 上的数值路径差异（engine 读回已窄化 BF16 再加宽，prepare 直接用 FP32 寄存器值）正是本次修订后各自忠实记录的实例。

conclusions.subject: coverage
conclusions.text: 通过。范围分清、root 无隐式兼底：root 的 when 是 selector 取真且 total_tokens >= 32（该下界唯一来源是 EncodeBetaTma<32,false> 的 kBoxTokens=32 校验，直绑 beta 行数 total_tokens 与补齐工作区行数 max(total_tokens,16) 都受约）；prepare_chain 的 when 是同一 selector 取假，且经核实确实不需 total_tokens 下界：EncodeBt16NativeBetaTma 只校验连续、基址 16 字节对齐与 cols*rows*2 <= 512，token 维写成上取整而无最小值，chain 使用的 EncodeValueTma<64,16> 只要求 token 轴 > 0，其余服务条件为 total_chunks > 0、prepare_total_ctas ∈ [head_count, head_count*total_chunks] 与 grid_x == 2*request_count*head_count，在声明域（request_count >= 1、capacity >= 1）内恒成立。两份设计各自从共同输入贯通到全部三个输出，尾块（root 的 out_tail、prepare_chain 的 tail_zero 与 out_tail）、空工作（PREPARE 的 my_chunks=0、cadence==0 时 checkpoint_block 为 0 槽）与 padded 行中性均分别贯通，未把未提交、无工作与 no-op 混为一谈。selector 取真而 total_tokens < 32 的输入被冻结 host 拒绝这一覆盖空白如实保留，Contract 有效域未因此缩小。

conclusions.text: 通过。P2/P4 已识别机制与 P5 交接的新事实均有最终去处，目录记录直接定位真实基线对象，已无待绑定对象或未来链接：范围小节把 prepare 的编译期特化与 beta 直绑、host capacity 上界与可能为空的 rank、chain 的 checkpoint 粒度与自然顺序、五组因子工作区的跨 kernel 交接、两族共有的 _kda_plan 缓存与同流顺序提交，分别指向 PREPARE.Schedule 与 REALIZATION.Require、Math_reshape 的 chunk 编号步与 checkpoint 步、PREPARE/CHAIN 的 Decomposition 与 Mapping、Flow.Launch/Handoff 与 CHAIN.Schedule。三条变体记录的并列基线均已落实并逐项核实：变体一 -> PREPARE.Schedule Strategy、load:gate_beta 与 raw_beta（原生 pair-packed 直绑，head_count=12 的 432 字节 box 依赖 Require 钉住的 640 字节间隙）；变体二 -> CHAIN.Decomposition Strategy 与 Worktile_order 加 Prefer 的无 metadata 提交（该节点 sort_by_length 无对应对象）；变体三 -> CHAIN.Mapping Strategy 与 Forbid，host 侧 chain_launch.cu::ResolveStatePointerSlots 调用同一 ResolveAndCheckServingStatePoolForDtype，设备侧 state_slot = seq_idx、四个状态索引实参为死实参（两个 FP32 指针由 StatePointerSlots 初始化为 nullptr）。全部结构化引用可解析，来源引用一律固定到 commit 484902855fe…，source_validation 为 verified。
